# library-build — build a media + knowledge library on ANY topic.
#
# One instance = one library for one topic. Created by the `curator` skill from
# a natural-language brief ("build a library on Orlando Florida tourism"). The
# topic is the only input; everything else is derived.
#
# The line, as pure dataflow (steps advance themselves on artifact state):
#
#   scope ──> subtopic[]           broad research swarm: enumerate the topic's
#     │                            sub-angles (adults, kids, theme parks, nature,
#     │                            dining, shopping, logistics, events, …)
#     ▼  (map, one run per subtopic, fans out wide)
#   research ──> subtopic[$i].dossier
#     │                            research one subtopic deeply — web + social
#     │                            signal (last30days) — and list the media
#     │                            worth acquiring (YouTube URLs, pages, PDFs,
#     │                            images), each with a why. Writes an OKF
#     │                            dossier doc.
#     ▼  (map over the DOSSIERS — a chained map; gates per-element on the
#     │   dossier being green, the behaviour fixed in liveloop's eligibility)
#   acquire ──> subtopic[$i].assets
#     │                            run the matching producer playbook for each
#     │                            candidate (youtube-clipper / web-markdown /
#     │                            pdf-images / social-signal): download, chop,
#     │                            transcribe, write one asset dir per artifact.
#     ▼  (on: allGreen — a fork-join barrier; fires only once EVERY dossier and
#         EVERY asset manifest is green, i.e. the whole swarm has landed)
#   wiki ──> index               build the OKF knowledge layer: an index + entity
#                                pages linking every dossier and asset into a
#                                browsable, portable wiki.
#
# Output goes to a per-topic library root — its own dir/repo (e.g.
# /User…

artifact (every dossier AND every asset manifest AND the seal) is
    # green. `generates:` (not `produces:`) is the right declaration for a leaf
    # no downstream loop consumes, and keeps its requiredInputs empty so the
    # allGreen firing's empty fingerprint matches at green time. The curator
    # passes the library root in this step's dispatch (it owns that context).
    on: [allGreen]            # fork-join barrier: the whole swarm must land first
    generates: [index]
    model: opus               # synthesis + knowledge structure — worth the strong model
    maxRunsPerDay: 20
    body: |
      Workflow ${WORKFLOW}, run ${RUN}. The whole swarm has landed (every dossier
      and every asset manifest is green). Build the OKF knowledge layer at the
      library root given in your dispatch (paths below are relative to it).

      - Walk research/*.md (dossiers) and assets/**/meta.yaml (assets).
      - Write wiki/index.md (OKF type: index): the topic overview, a link to every
        subtopic dossier, and a media gallery grouped by type (video / audio /
        image / pdf / web) linking each asset's dir.
      - Add entity pages (OKF type: entity) for the cross-cutting things worth a
        page of their own (major places, attractions, recurring themes), each
        linking the dossiers and assets that mention it. Markdown links between
        these files ARE the knowledge graph — wire them densely.

      Green `index` with
      {"index":"wiki/index.md","dossiers":<n>,"assets":<n>,"entities":<n>}.
